claimsDigest.description: Present when the freeze hashed the questions (each claim's id, statement and dependencies) as well as the content. Absent on subjects frozen before the field existed: such a subject answered 'which content', and inventing a question for it would let a stale answer pass as a current one.

declaredPaths.description: The paths as declared, before directory expansion. A declared directory expands into the files it held at the freeze, and the drift check compares against the declaration rather than the expansion — otherwise a file added inside it later is invisible. Absent on subjects frozen before the field existed.
